query: On ROCm, model loading became ~15x slower: per-tensor ~0.5s fixed overhead when .to(device) copies mmap-backed safetensors tensors (cost scales with tensor count).

desired.outcome: OP guayar (C1) root-caused it and --disable-mmap 'completely fixed' load times; independently confirmed by zenmasterzardoz (C2, gfx1100) and boxwrench (C4, 0.33.2). Underlying per-tensor mmap-transfer defect still needs a core fix honoring disable_mmap everywhere.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
